The Dynamic Lugano DYN-6336-03 FS is a 3-person full spectrum infrared sauna designed for buyers who want complete infrared therapy — near, mid, and far wavelengths together — in a spacious, well-appointed home cabin. With near zero EMF under 3 MG at 2–3 inches from the heating elements and a 9-heater array that covers the full interior, this is one of the most thorough 3-person infrared saunas available for home installation.

Full spectrum infrared matters because each wavelength does something different. FAR infrared has the longest wavelength and does most of the heating. MID infrared sits between the two, reducing pain, and supporting circulation. NEAR infrared is the shortest of the three wavelengths and is absorbed closest to the skin. In a single session, the Lugano delivers all three simultaneously in a layered, complementary system that a standard FAR-only sauna cannot replicate.

The heating system consists of 9 total heaters: 6 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared carbon panels and 3 Near infrared elements, positioned across the walls and below the bench for even, full-body coverage. The near zero EMF rating keeps electromagnetic output under 3 MG at close proximity — making extended daily sessions comfortable for health-conscious users. The interior chromotherapy color lighting system with Red Light Therapy provides therapeutic light wavelengths during every session, while exterior accent lighting gives the cabin a polished, premium look in any room. Temperature operates ideally between 118°F and 132°F, with a maximum of 140°F.

Controls are accessible from both inside and outside the cabin via interior and exterior LED control panels. The Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary audio system with built-in speakers and pre-amp integrates your audio seamlessly without needing an external device. The bronze-tinted tempered glass door and roof vent give the Lugano a distinctive, premium aesthetic that sets it apart from the clear-glass models in the Dynamic lineup — the bronze tint adds privacy and a warmer visual tone without reducing natural light inside. The clasp-together panel assembly is designed for two people without special tools, and the unit ships in 3 boxes.

The Lugano requires a 120V/20 AMP dedicated Non-GFCI receptacle and breaker — this is not a standard plug-and-play outlet connection like the lower-capacity Dynamic models. A dedicated circuit is required, and a licensed electrician should be consulted if one is not already in place at your installation site.

Built from natural reforested Canadian Hemlock with a Honey Dark Stain finish, the Lugano is suited for a home gym, basement, master bath, walk-in closet, or dedicated wellness room. It is designed for indoor use only.

Dynamic Saunas is produced by Golden Designs, Inc., a California-based company with a focused specialty in home infrared sauna wellness products. The full spectrum line uses PureTech™ heating technology to achieve near zero EMF FAR infrared output alongside dedicated near infrared elements — a combination that delivers the widest possible infrared therapeutic range in a home-ready format. The 5-year limited warranty covers wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics.
